name: New Bark Cave + Free TM/HM Shop
description: The cave's northwest shop now offers all 50 TMs and all seven HMs for ¥0 from the left clerk. Choose TMs, then a group of ten, or choose HMs. The right clerk still offers free Potions, healing items and Poké/Great/Ultra/Master Balls. Includes earlier cave, six-starter and EXP-option features.
notes: Back up your normal cartridge save before upgrading. Use CONTINUE; older saves made inside the shop refresh both clerks' script references. Save layout, existing map IDs and cave position recovery are preserved. TMs remain single-use with unlimited free restocking; HMs are reusable and field use still requires badges. Normal bag limits apply; other marts keep normal prices. Numbered states remain specific to their exact ROM. Complete playthrough remains unverified.
